annotations.title: Check which planets are retrograde, and until when

description:
Reports which planets are retrograde on a date and the two stations that OPEN AND CLOSE each body's current period ("since 2026-02-14, until 2026-03-07"). Per body: retrograde flag, ecliptic longitude, longitude speed, sign and degree, and both stations with exact UTC instants.

DELEGATE THIS RATHER THAN DERIVING IT: the dates move every cycle and follow no rule; Mercury turns three or four times a year and those dates get misremembered by a week. A station is where longitude speed crosses zero, found by bisection for eight bodies, so this is slower than the others.

EXCLUDED: the Sun and Moon, which cannot station, and Rahu and Ketu, which always move backwards. Quote the "excluded" array.

CITATION: required. See server instructions.

date.description: The date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD, 1700-2200. Example: "2026-03-01". Omit: today (UTC).

time.description: Time of day HH:MM in UTC, not local and not a birth time. Example: "12:00". Matters within a day of a station.
